## uiux_design_system_card

> Square design-system showcase card highlighting a single component or token with prop rows.

**Artifact:** `poster`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/uiux/_vars_examples/design_system_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A square reference card from the ATLAS DESIGN SYSTEM design system showcasing the Button / Primary component. The card frames a minimal preview of the component at the top half, a two-row prop table beneath, and a single-line usage caption at the bottom.
[2. Action] The component sits at rest in its default state. The viewer reads the system name first, identifies the component label, scans the two prop rows, and finishes on the usage caption. No interaction state, no hover, no overlap with sibling components.
[3. Scene] Documentation-grade flat surface. No physical environment. Ground is paper-white (#FFFFFF) with an optional 1px outer hairline border framing the entire card. No shadow, no scene depth.
[4. Composition] Square 1:1 frame. Top ~12% reserved for the system name set in small-caps and the component label set as a larger heading immediately below. Middle ~48% holds the rendered component preview, centered with generous whitespace on all sides. Below the preview sits a horizontal divider rule, then a two-row prop table where each row pairs a property name (left) with its value (right) in monospace. Bottom ~10% holds the usage caption left-aligned beneath a second divider rule. Outer canvas padding is 64px.
[5. Style] Minimal documentation aesthetic — Linear / Radix / shadcn feel. Plenty of whitespace, fine 1px slate-200 dividers, restrained palette (off-white field, near-black type, single muted accent for active state). Type pairing: a precise sans-serif (Inter or Geist) for headings and copy, a monospace cut (JetBrains Mono or Geist Mono) for prop names and values. No drop shadows, no gradients, no decorative ornament.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- system_name: "ATLAS DESIGN SYSTEM"
- component_label: "Button / Primary"
- prop_row_1: "size: md | lg"
- prop_row_2: "variant: solid | outline"
- usage_caption: "Use as the primary call-to-action; one per view."

NO: busy backgrounds, 3D component renders, glossy highlights, photographic textures, rainbow palettes, hand-drawn sketch, clip-art icons, watermarks, drop shadows beyond 1px
```

## uiux_ios_app_mockup

> Hyper-realistic iPhone app screenshot mockup with native iOS chrome and a card-based content feed.

**Artifact:** `mockup`, `1088x1920`, aspect `9:16`
**Demo vars:** `templates/uiux/_vars_examples/ios_app_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A hyper-realistic iPhone screenshot for Stillwater captured as if pulled directly from a current-generation iOS device. The frame contains the system status bar, a primary header titled Today, a scrollable card feed in the body, and a three-tab bottom navigation bar. The render reads as a single full-bleed device screen, no device bezel ringing the edges.
[2. Action] The interface sits in its default at-rest state — no animations, no loading skeletons. The eye lands on the header, scans the two stacked content cards, and registers the active tab in the bottom bar. Tap targets feel native; nothing implies motion or transition.
[3. Scene] Pure on-device pixel field with no surrounding desk, hand, or photographic environment. The lock screen is not visible; the user is already inside the app. Background is an off-white system surface (#5B8DEF reserved for accent strokes only).
[4. Composition] Vertical 9:16 frame matching iPhone Pro proportions. Top ~5% holds the iOS status bar (current time left, signal/wifi/battery icons right). Below that a fixed header band (~9%) contains the screen title and a discreet trailing-icon button. Body (~70%) shows two rounded card rows with strong corner radius (~24px) and subtle 1px hairline borders. Bottom ~10% is the tab bar with three evenly distributed icon-plus-label tabs. Generous 24px gutters throughout.
[5. Style] Hyper-realistic iOS 18-era aesthetic. SF Pro typography, soft pastel rounded cards, soft drop shadows behind elevated surfaces, single accent color #5B8DEF reserved for the active tab, primary header chevron, and small CTA chips. Material feels like brushed glass over a faint paper surface; no gradients beyond a 2-step very subtle wash inside cards. Pixel-perfect, no Android cues.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- header_title: "Today"
- nav_tab_1: "Home"
- nav_tab_2: "Sessions"
- nav_tab_3: "Profile"
- card_1_title: "Morning Breathwork"
- card_1_subtitle: "5 min · guided · level 1"
- card_2_title: "Evening Wind-down"
- card_2_subtitle: "12 min · ambient · level 2"

NO: Android UI patterns, Material Design ripples, low-fi wireframe sketch, hand-drawn UI, device bezel ring, lens flare, desktop browser chrome, watermarks, rainbow gradients, 3D extruded buttons
```

## uiux_web_dashboard

> Clean B2B SaaS analytics dashboard mockup with sidebar nav, KPI grid, and a primary chart.

**Artifact:** `mockup`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/uiux/_vars_examples/web_dashboard_demo.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A pixel-perfect web dashboard mockup for Northwind Analytics rendered as if captured from a 16:9 desktop viewport. The composition includes a left sidebar with a five-item primary navigation, a top header band, a 3-column row of KPI cards, a hero chart panel below the KPIs, and a small data table pinned to the bottom.
[2. Action] The interface is at rest. The viewer scans top-to-bottom: brand and nav anchor identity, KPI cards deliver instant proof, the chart answers "trend over Last 12 months", and the table grounds the numbers. No tooltips, modals, or loading states.
[3. Scene] Pure on-screen field. No browser chrome, no OS window controls, no desktop wallpaper visible. Background is a soft off-white SaaS surface (#F7F8FA) with a faint 8-pixel light grey grid optionally visible behind cards.
[4. Composition] Left rail (~14% width) holds the Northwind Analytics wordmark up top and five vertical nav rows below, each with a tiny leading icon and label. The remaining content area carries a 64px-tall header strip showing the chart title at left and a date-range pill (Last 12 months) at right. Below the header, three KPI cards span the row at equal width with 24px gutters. Below that, a single hero chart panel occupies ~45% of vertical space; underneath, a tabular block fills the remaining bottom. Outer canvas padding is 32px.
[5. Style] Clean B2B SaaS aesthetic in a contemporary Linear / Vercel / Tailwind UI cut. White cards on the off-white field, 1px slate-200 hairline borders, 12px corner radius, single restrained accent color (deep indigo or emerald) used only for active nav row, KPI delta arrows, and the hero chart line. Type system: Inter at 13/14/15px body and 22/28px display. No drop shadows beyond a 1px hairline; no glassmorphism, no gradients.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- product_name: "Northwind Analytics"
- nav_label_1: "Overview"
- nav_label_2: "Revenue"
- nav_label_3: "Cohorts"
- nav_label_4: "Pipeline"
- nav_label_5: "Settings"
- kpi_1_label: "Net New ARR"
- kpi_2_label: "Active Customers"
- kpi_3_label: "Gross Margin"
- chart_title: "Monthly recurring revenue"
- period: "Last 12 months"

NO: photographic background, 3D charts, rainbow palette, glassmorphism blur, dark-mode neon, clip-art icons, stock-photo people, hand-drawn sketch, watermarks, lens flare
```
